title: A privileged role lacks phishing-resistant authentication

messages.businessImpact: An administrator can satisfy a weaker sign-in challenge with a method that an attacker may be able to phish, even when ordinary multi-factor authentication is required.
messages.technicalDetail: Each assigned role counts as covered only when every holder is reached by an enabled policy over all cloud resources and sign-in contexts. The built-in phishing-resistant strength or a custom strength allowing only Windows Hello for Business, FIDO2 and multi-factor certificate methods counts. An OR grant with alternative controls does not require the strength.
remediation: Require the phishing-resistant MFA authentication strength for the affected built-in directory role across all cloud resources.
Register appropriate methods for administrators and test the policy in report-only mode before enabling it.
Keep emergency access accounts available under a separately tested recovery procedure.
messages.cannotSee: Group membership behind Conditional Access inclusions or exclusions is not resolved to administrators. A relevant policy with unresolved targeting or strength makes this check unavailable rather than claiming absence. Policies with different application or sign-in limits are not combined to infer full coverage. User-scoped Conditional Access does not assess service principals.
